'''Wormtown''' was an area of the [[Hutt Space]] [[moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa]] that contained the [[Fighting pit|pit]] fighting [[Garkata Fighting Arena]]. [[Boba Fett]] traveled to the [[City|town]] during the [[Galactic Civil War]] to [[Death|eliminate]] [[Wyrmen Lictor]], the champion of the arena. During Fett's fights, he also killed the combatant [[Jonny the Sting]], who was considered a favorite among Wormtown residents.<ref name="Alpha 1" /> After Lictor was killed at the [[bounty hunter]]'s [[Limb|hands]], [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]] agents [[Luke Skywalker]], [[Chewbacca]], and the [[droid]]s [[R2-D2]] and [[C-3PO]] traveled to Wormtown in search of Fett and came into conflict with the [[Kanji Criminal Enterprise]].<ref name="SW 13">[[Star Wars (2020) 13|''Star Wars'' (2020) 13]]</ref>
